Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misdirected the search by instructing WebSurfer to open a Wikisource page for “Father, Son and Holy Ghost” (a Charles Wesley hymn) to find Audre Lorde’s poem, failing to validate author/source relevance before proceeding. This conflation of works/authors led to wasted effort and hindered obtaining the correct poem text needed to identify the stanza with indented lines.
